mapper.update: UPDATE /* LGVPAY00031.updatePaidLeaveEmp */ tb_pay_paid_leave_n SET start_date = TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'DD/MM/YYYY') , end_date = TO_DATE(#{endDate} , 'DD/MM/YYYY') , note = #{note} , last_update_user_id = #{applicationUserId} /* 최종수정사용자아이디 */ , last_update_date = SYSDATE /* 최종수정일자 */ WHERE paid_leave_id = #{paidLeaveId}

UPDATE /* LGVPAY00031.saveCalculateAttendancePLPlan */ tb_att_plan_n tap SET tap.time_and_attendance_code = 'PL' , tap.overtime_sum_hours = 0 , tap.time_attend_detail_code = #{paidLeaveDetailCode} , tap.base_time_attend_apply_flag = 'N' , tap.last_update_user_id = #{applicationUserId} , tap.last_update_date = SYSDATE WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tb_pay_paid_leave_n tpp WHERE tpp.employee_no = tap.employee_no AND tap.time_and_attendance_date BETWEEN tpp.start_date AND tpp.end_date AND tpp.payment_yyyymm = #{payMonth} AND tpp.paid_leave_detail_code = #{paidLeaveDetailCode} ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tb_att_base_bas_n b WHERE b.shift_type_code = tap.shift_type_code AND b.time_and_attendance_date = tap.time_and_attendance_date AND b.time_and_attendance_code != 'PH' ) AND tap.time_and_attendance_code NOT IN ('PL', 'PH', 'WH', 'US', 'NN')

UPDATE /* LGVPAY00031.saveCalculateAttendancePLActual */ tb_att_result_n tar SET tar.time_and_attendance_code = 'PL' , tar.work_hours = 0 , tar.overtime_sum_hours = 0 , tar.weekday_overtime_hours = 0 , tar.holiday_overtime_hours = 0 , tar.public_holiday_overtime_hours = 0 , tar.weekday_night_overtime_hours = 0 , tar.weekday_ot_af_night_work_hours = 0 , tar.holiday_night_overtime_hours = 0 , tar.public_holiday_night_ot_hours = 0 , tar.normal_night_overtime_hours = 0 , tar.tardy_hours = 0 , tar.early_leave_hours = 0 , tar.going_out_hours = 0 , tar.time_attend_detail_code = #{paidLeaveDetailCode} , tar.time_attend_input_reason_desc = 'Paid Leave Registration (LGVPAY00031)' , tar.base_time_attend_apply_flag = 'N' , tar.last_update_user_id = #{applicationUserId} , tar.last_update_date = SYSDATE WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tb_pay_paid_leave_n tpp WHERE tpp.employee_no = tar.employee_no AND tar.time_and_attendance_date BETWEEN tpp.start_date AND tpp.end_date AND tpp.payment_yyyymm = #{payMonth} AND tpp.paid_leave_detail_code = #{paidLeaveDetailCode} ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tb_att_base_bas_n b WHERE b.shift_type_code = tar.shift_type_code AND b.time_and_attendance_date = tar.time_and_attendance_date AND b.time_and_attendance_code != 'PH' ) AND tar.time_and_attendance_code NOT IN ('PL', 'PH', 'WH', 'US', 'NN')
mapper.select: SELECT /* LGVPAY00031.retrieveEmployeeInfo */ em.employee_number AS employee_no , em.full_name_english AS employee_name , em.org_name_local AS organization_name , em.assignment_category AS emp_category_code , DECODE(em.assignment_category, 'LGD_OW', 'OW', 'LGD_LW', 'LW', em.assignment_category) AS emp_category_name , (SELECT lgvhr_common_pkg.decode_lookup('LGVHR_SHIFT_TYPE_CODE', em.attribute10, NULL, #{USER_SESSION.languageCode}) FROM DUAL) AS shift_type_name , em.grade AS grade_code , TO_CHAR(em.date_hire_subsidiary, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS date_hire_subsidiary , TO_CHAR(em.date_retire, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS date_retire FROM emp_master em WHERE em.employee_number = #{employeeNo}

{call lgvpay_paid_leave_pkg.upload_paid_leave_emp(#{errorCode, mode=OUT, jdbcType=VARCHAR, javaType=string}, /* p_errcode */ #{errorMsg , mode=OUT, jdbcType=VARCHAR, javaType=string}, /* p_errbuf */ #{sessionId, mode=IN , jdbcType=NUMERIC, javaType=string}, /* p_session_id */ #{payMonth , mode=IN , jdbcType=VARCHAR, javaType=string}, /* p_pay_month */ #{paidLeaveDetailCode , mode=IN, jdbcType=VARCHAR, javaType=string}, /* p_paid_leave_detail_code */ #{applicationUserId, mode=IN , jdbcType=NUMERIC, javaType=string} /* p_application_user_id */ )}
